welcome.title: Welcome to Wager!
welcome.subtitle: Let's get your pay tracking set up in under 2 minutes.
welcome.description: We need a few quick details to calculate your earnings accurately:

trackPay.title: Track Pay
trackPay.description: Calculate standard pay, 6-day bonuses, and performance bonuses automatically

weeklyCalendar.title: Weekly Calendar
weeklyCalendar.description: Log work days, sweeps, and mileage with an intuitive calendar view

vanTracking.title: Van Tracking
vanTracking.description: Track van hire costs, deposits, and mileage discrepancies

customizable.title: Customizable
customizable.description: Adjust rates, mileage, and settings to match your DSP's pay structure

payRates.title: Your Daily Pay Rates
payRates.subtitle: These rates are used to calculate your weekly earnings

disclaimer.title: Not sure about your rates?
disclaimer.description: Check with your manager to confirm your exact daily rates. You can always update these later in Settings.

invoicing.title: Invoicing Service
invoicing.subtitle: Choose how you handle invoicing and accounting

selfInvoicing.label: Self-Invoicing
selfInvoicing.description: Handle your own invoicing and tax returns

invoicing.info: This affects your weekly deductions. You can change this anytime in Settings.

vanHire.title: Do you have a van on hire?
vanHire.subtitle: We can help you track van costs, deposits, and mileage
vanHire.yesDescription: Set up van hire details and start tracking costs
vanHire.noDescription: I don't have a van or I'll add it later
vanHire.info: You can add or manage van hires anytime from the Van Management page

vanHireForm.title: Add Your Van Hire
vanHireForm.subtitle: Enter your van details to start tracking costs and deposits
vanHireForm.vanTypeFleetHelp: Fixed rate rental van at £250 per week
vanHireForm.vanTypeFlexiHelp: Company van with variable weekly cost (£100-250)
vanHireForm.onHireDateHelp: When did you start hiring this van?
vanHireForm.depositInfo: We'll automatically track your deposit payments (£25 for your first 2 pay cheques, then £50 per pay cheque until you reach £500 total).

success.title: You're All Set! 🎉
success.subtitle: Your pay tracking is ready to go. Here's what you can do:

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Track daily work, sweeps, and mileage with a visual weekly view

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Quick adds for work, sweeps, and odometer readings. See payment breakdowns.

vanManagement.title: Van Management
vanManagement.description: Track van hire costs, deposits, and off-hire dates

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Customize rates, mileage, and invoicing service anytime

tour.title: Want to see how it works first?
tour.description: Take a quick guided tour of the dashboard to explore all features

dashboardQuickAddWork.title: Quick Add Work
dashboardQuickAddWork.description: Add today's work quickly from the dashboard. Select your route type and the app auto-calculates your daily rate.

dashboardPayment.title: Payment This Week
dashboardPayment.description: See your expected bank deposit with full breakdown. This shows Week N-2 standard pay plus Week N-6 performance bonus.

dashboardVanStatus.title: Van Status
dashboardVanStatus.description: Track your van deposit progress and weekly costs. See how much you've paid and how much remains to reach £500.

calendarNavigation.title: Week Navigation
calendarNavigation.description: Navigate between weeks to view past and future work. Use Previous, Today, and Next buttons or jump to a specific week.

calendarDayCell.title: Day Cells
calendarDayCell.description: Click any day to view details or add work. Each cell shows route type, pay, sweeps, and mileage at a glance.

calendarWeekSummary.title: Week Summary
calendarWeekSummary.description: Full pay breakdown including base pay, 6-day bonus, sweeps, mileage, and van costs. Enter performance rankings here too.

calendarPaymentThisWeek.title: Payment This Week
calendarPaymentThisWeek.description: See what's hitting your bank account this week. Standard pay from 2 weeks ago plus performance bonus from 6 weeks ago.

vanManagementTop.title: Van Management - Add & Track
vanManagementTop.description: Use this top section to add new van hires and track your deposit progress. The deposit tracker shows how much you've paid and what remains.

vanManagementBottom.title: Van Management - Van History
vanManagementBottom.description: View all your van hires here. See active vans, off-hired vans, and manage your complete van history.

tourComplete.title: Ready to Track Your Pay!
tourComplete.description: You've completed the tour! Click the Quick Add Work tile above to log your first day, or explore at your own pace.

modal.title: Onboarding Wizard
modal.description: Complete the setup process to get started with Wager

toast.vanAddFailed: Failed to add van hire. You can add it later from Van Management.
toast.welcomeMessage: Welcome to Wager! Start tracking your pay.
toast.savingSettingsFailed: Failed to save settings. Please try again.
